subject.statement: René Benko wurde im Oktober 2025 vom Landesgericht Innsbruck zu zwei Jahren Haft verurteilt.

summary: As of my knowledge cutoff in mid‑2024, René Benko was under investigation but had not been convicted or sentenced to imprisonment; no credible reports of a two‑year prison sentence handed down by the Innsbruck Regional Court in October 2025 have appeared in reliable sources up to that date.
